rows.answer: I couldn't find the inherent powers of a civil court in the Acts I searched, as the sources only mention that Section 151 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 preserves the inherent power of the Court to make such orders as may be necessary for the ends of justice or to prevent abuse of the process of the Court [1].
